thread:
Leah (AE): Hey team — RealCorp asked for our SOC 2 report as part of procurement. They want to review in detail before a week-long POC. Their legal asked for our standard NDA + a clause that nothing can be retained beyond their review window. Any preferred approach?

Omar (Security): We usually avoid sharing the raw report PDF. Options: 1) redacted report (remove customer-specific artifacts), 2) a secure viewer session (watermarked/read-only), or 3) a signed access addendum that limits retention and redisclosure.

Priya (Legal): If they want a no-retention clause, that's an exception to our standard NDA. We can do a one-off "access addendum" that: a) permits viewing only, b) prohibits copying/redistribution, c) requires acknowledgement and audit logging. Need a quick heads-up on scope so I can draft.

Leah (AE): Customer prefers minimal friction — they'd accept a timed view in a secure portal + a signed confirmation from us. POC needs to start Monday, so ~5 business days.

Jin (Solutions Eng): Technically easiest is a short-lived secure link with watermark and IP-based restrictions. We can enable logging and revoke after window. Example presign pattern (if we use S3):

```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-secure/soc2-redacted.pdf --expires-in 43200
```
But if Legal wants an audit trail in our portal, we can host a read-only session with enforced screenshots disabled at the viewer level.

Priya (Legal): I prefer the portal/read-only session + access addendum. It covers our risk better than handing a file. Draft points I need: who on their side will sign, retention window, whether reviewers can download notes, and any third-party reviewers.

Omar (Security): Also request they accept redaction of vendor-specific customer IDs and any SOC 2 evidence attachments. We can provide control descriptions and the attestation pages in full.

Leah (AE): Customer contact: erin@realcorp.com. She said reviewers are internal procurement + security (3 people). They asked for 48-hour access. They also asked if we can sign an NDA exception that says no copies retained.

Priya (Legal): 48 hours is short but okay. I'll prepare an access addendum template and the NDA exception language. ETA: draft in ~6 hours for internal review, can send to Erin after signoff.

Jin (Solutions Eng): I'll stand up the viewer and capture the audit logs. Can we do watermarking with reviewer emails?

Priya (Legal): Yes — require them to provide reviewer full names and emails, include watermark clause in addendum.

devops-bot: Presigned viewer session provision requested by Jin. Session id = svc-9c3b. Access policy: read-only, watermark enabled, expires = 48h, audit-log enabled. (This is an automated status message.)

Leah (AE): Perfect — plan: Priya drafts addendum, Jin prepares viewer + logs, Omar finalizes redaction list. I'll coordinate with Erin for reviewer names. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Priya (Legal): One more: include a clause that we can retain audit logs for incident response (not content). I'll add that language.

Leah (AE): Got it. I'll loop Erin in once Priya shares the draft.

Omar (Security): If procurement pushes for a copy, we push back and offer an attested PDF (redacted) only after exec approval. Not a first-line offering.

Leah (AE): Noted. Closing this thread — will post update after Erin confirms reviewers.
